newsitem.title: UK: Regal Hotel prices 35 mln stg debenture.
newsitem.headline: Regal Hotel prices 35 mln stg debenture.

text.p: The 35 million stg debenture stock issue for Regal Hotel Group Plc has been priced, joint lead managers Salomon Brothers International and Dresdner Kleinwort Benson said on Friday.
The nine percent issue due June 30, 2006 has an issue price of 102.041, to give a spread of 99 b.p. over gilts. The payment date is May 29.
The issue will be used to partly fund the acquisition of 13 three-star hotels from Whitbred Plc.
The new stock will accrue from May 30, 1997 and will become fungible with existing 80 million stg issue launched in April 1996.
